mike_sales: AM pulse — quick updates from me: 3 active deals. NovaCorp needs SSO + BYOK/EKM answers; Legal wants DPA signed. KernelHealth is asking for Dedicated pricing and a throughput SLA. Blocker: waiting on security guidance for customer-managed keys. Ping @ana_enterprise for NovaCorp timing.

ana_enterprise: On NovaCorp — call booked for 11:30 PT with their infra lead. They'll send IdP metadata during the call. Can we get a concise SSO + BYOK checklist to send ahead?

devon_se: I have a draft checklist in the sales playbook (docs/sales/sso-byok-checklist.md). Quick snippet:
```
- SAML metadata + ACS/EntityID
- Assertion attributes (email, groups)
- Required cert algs (RSA2048/PSA)
- BYOK/EKM: vendor, key lifecycle, rotation cadence, HSM type
- Audit/logging retention needs
```
I'll sharpen it for NovaCorp and attach before your call.

sarah_salesops: KernelHealth update: finance gave a preliminary thumbs-up on Dedicated pricing but want exact GPU count and burst terms. No blockers from ops; just need the final quote line items.

oliver_sec: Security note: if customer requires BYOK with external HSM, we need vendor attestation (FIPS/HSM model) and confirmation on key import flow. Also need to confirm whether they want customer key material persisted on our side or strictly on the HSM. @mike_sales share their ask and timeline?

mike_sales: Shared the timeline in DM — they want POC in ~2 weeks but will accept a 1-week targeted plan if we can commit on the SSO checklist + EKM gap analysis. I told them we'd try for 48-72h for a gap doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: DPA template available in /legal/templates/dpa_v3.pdf — use branch 'sales-dpa' for edits.

devon_se: CR ping — PR #452 updates the SSO checklist and includes EKM options. Small wording change. @mike_sales can you review?

mike_sales: Will review PR #452 after the NovaCorp call.

oliver_sec: I'll run a quick BYOK gap analysis after standup and post a 1-pager by EOD today. If we need vendor attestations sooner, @sarah_salesops can you pull SOC2 summary and recent pen test report?

sarah_salesops: Yep — I have SOC2 kit and pen test summary ready, will upload to the deal folder and DM the link.

ana_enterprise: One more customer ask: could we offer short-lived tokens (STS) as an alternative to full BYOK? They prefer BYOK but asked about intermediate options. I said we'd surface tradeoffs.

oliver_sec: STS helps reduce key surface but doesn't satisfy BYOK compliance for some customers. Gap analysis will include STS vs BYOK pros/cons.

mike_sales: Sounds good. Action items: devon -> finalize checklist and attach before 11:30; oliver -> gap analysis by EOD; sarah -> upload SOC2 + pen test; mike -> review PR + follow-up w/ NovaCorp.

ana_enterprise: Great — I'll confirm call agenda and ask them to send IdP metadata in advance. :thumbsup:

devon_se: Quick note — small doc edit pushed, no functional changes. :ok_hand:

oliver_sec: Starting analysis now. Will post updates here. :eyes:
